text: The language of Kestrel-3 is Erlang, which new contributors must know.

Unlike Kestrel-3, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Egret-6 is the Sprocket team. Nobody should assume the owner of Egret-6 applies to Kestrel-3, the owner differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
